title: feat(app-shell,components): Open the full form on an AI chat update card applies its proposed changes, before → after; a record in a list drawer is the chat's record in view
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-zhuang"} -->
_Requested by **Sam** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01GsBogozeZG5sdpAARrN7HP?thread=cmsg_01GsBogozeZG5sdpAARrN7HPEvrGVfJq9tc5dC5mUCKJAd)_

Closes #28106

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：AI 聊天里的「修改记录」卡片点「打开完整表单」时，编辑页现在带着 AI 建议的新值打开：每个字段显示原值和新值，标「AI 建议」，可以逐个还原，不会自动保存。另外，列表页右侧抽屉打开某条记录时，聊天也会知道「这条」指的是哪条记录。
- 为什么改：之前点「打开完整表单」只打开原记录，AI 建议的修改要用户重新输入一遍；抽屉里问「把这条电话改成……」时 AI 不知道是哪条记录。
- 风险与回滚：只改控制台界面（三个前端包），不动规格和服务端；值走路由状态，不进网址。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx`（建议值的应用、原值行和还原按钮）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordFormPage.tsx`（编辑页读取建议值）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/chatSurfaceContext.ts`（抽屉记录）。
- 两分钟验证：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/components/src/renderers/form/__tests__/form-aiSuggestedMark-28104.test.tsx`，预期 11 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The card's premise was re-measured before any code; two of its four items had already moved:

- **Item 1 (record page sends the ask context) was already done** by objectstack#30043: the console dock sends `context.surface = { artifact: { type: 'object', name }, selection: { kind: 'record', id } }` on every record route (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/chatSurfaceContext.ts`, `ConsoleLayout.tsx`), and cloud reads it (`service-ai/src/turn-grounding.ts`, whose record-focus block points the agent at `update_record`). What was still open is the record **drawer**: `?recordId=` over a list was read off the pathname only, so the dock sent the object alone. That gap is closed here.
- **Item 2 (`open_record` with `proposedValues`) has no producer any more.** cloud#3565 removed that arm from `open_record` ("one way to propose a change, not two", `service-ai-studio/src/tools/open-record.tool.ts` header). An edit from chat is now `update_record`, rendered as the record-write card. A consumer for `proposedValues` would be dead code, so it is not built.
- **What survives of items 2 and 3**, accepted by the dispatching seat: the update card's "Open the full form" opened `/record/:id/edit` on the stored record alone, so every change the card proposed had to be typed again. It now carries the card's proposed values there, through the router-state carrier objectstack#28104 introduced, and the edit form shows each as before → after, marked with the same 「AI 建议」 mark, with a per-field revert, and never submits on its own.

### The changes

1. **Drawer context** (`chatSurfaceContext.ts`, `ConsoleLayout.tsx`): on the three list routes (`:objectName`, `:objectName/data`, `:objectName/view/:viewId`), a non-empty `?recordId=` (`RECORD_DRAWER_PARAM`) makes the surface name the object and that record, exactly the shape the record page sends. The New page, a record page and pages with no artifact read as before. Same `context.surface` shape, no second one.
2. **Carrier** (`utils/recordFormAiDraft.ts`): `recordWriteFormTarget` gives an update the same `recordFormAiDraft` state key, now with the `recordId` the values were proposed for. Every named field is kept, an empty one included (clearing a field is a change). `readRecordFormAiChanges(state, recordId)` reads it for that record only; `readRecordFormAiDraft` (the create reader) ignores a draft that names a record. Nothing is added to the URL.
3. **Edit page** (`views/RecordFormPage.tsx`): in edit mode it reads the changes for its own record and provides them through the new `SuggestedFieldChangesContext`, and shows the same one-line notice the create page shows (`form.aiDraftNotice`). It still opens on the stored record: no create values, no `SuggestedFieldsContext`.
4. **Form renderer** (`components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx`, `suggested-fields-context.ts`): the new host slot `SuggestedFieldChangesContext` (field name → proposed value) is the edit-form sibling of #28104's `SuggestedFieldsContext`. The renderer applies each proposed value **once**, on the first reset that brings the record, **after** the reset window, with `setValue(…, { shouldDirty: true })`: the form reads dirty, the discard guard hears it, the value channels report it, and the save payload (which diffs against the loaded record) writes it, exactly as the person's own edit would. A proposal equal to the stored value, for a field the form does not draw, or for a statically read-only, disabled or hidden field is not applied. While the control holds the proposed value the field shows the #28104 mark (`form.aiSuggested`, the same span), a `Was: …` line with the stored value (option label, a lookup's name, a list joined, `empty` for none), and a **Revert** button that puts the stored value back; the person's own edit or the revert takes all three away.
5. **i18n**: `form.aiBefore`, `form.aiBeforeEmpty`, `form.aiRevert` in all eleven locale packs (no quote characters, so the de quote-pair count is unchanged).

No `packages/spec` path, no new metadata key: both contexts are host slots, and the update card's own buttons and labels are unchanged.

## Why

The record-write card (cloud#3565) is how chat proposes a change to one record; its "Open the full form" is the path for a person who wants to see the change in the whole form before saving. Opening that form without the change throws away what the card showed. And a record open in a list's drawer is as much "this record" as a record page.

## Tests

Pins, each with a CONTROL:

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/chatSurfaceContext-30043.test.ts`: new describe, drawer `?recordId=` on all three list routes, encoded id; controls for no or empty param, the view selection without a drawer, the New page, a record page, pages with no artifact and host routes.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/ChatDock.requestContext-30043.test.tsx`: new describe, the REAL dock's chat POST body names the drawer record, and the next turn after the drawer closes names the object only.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/__tests__/recordFormAiDraft-28104.test.ts`: the #28104 "an update carries no draft" case now pins the update's state; new describe for nothing in the URL, empty (clearing) values kept, binding to the record, and a create page never reading it.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordFormPage.aiDraft-28104.test.tsx`: new describe, the edit page hands the form the changes and shows the notice once, through a real `navigate(to, { state })` with nothing after the edit path, still opens on the stored record; controls for another record's draft, a create's draft, no state, and a create page given an update's state.
- `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/__tests__/form-aiSuggestedMark-28104.test.tsx`: new describe, a proposed change lands in the control, marked, with `Was: …` (option label for a select); a proposal equal to the stored value shows nothing; revert restores the stored value and removes mark, line and button; the person's own edit removes the mark; the form reports dirty; a read-only and an undrawn field are left alone and the save payload carries neither change; mounting submits nothing and Save submits the applied change; control with no provider.

### Ablation

Each leg mutated through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit x1 → x0, distinct marker x0 → x1, restore proven by blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`; the ui vitest config aliases `@object-ui/*` to `src`, so no build sits between the mutation and the run). The direction was written in each test file's header before the run.

| leg | mutation | red | green |
|---|---|---|---|
| A renderer | skip every proposal in the apply loop | lands-marked, revert, dirty/read-only, Save payload (4) | the five #28104 cells, the own-edit cell, CONTROL |
| B edit page | edit mode reads no changes | hands-the-form, navigate-with-state (2) | the six #28104 cells, stored-record, CONTROL |
| C drawer | ignore `?recordId=` | the drawer pin, the dock wire pin (2) | the other 15 |
| D carrier | update target drops its state | the two update-state pins (2) | the other 6 |

In leg A the own-edit cell stayed green because it then asserted only the absence of the mark after an edit; it now first asserts the mark is present, so it reds under the same mutation.

## Acceptance notes

- `open_record`'s `proposedValues` arm is gone from cloud (cloud#3565), so item 2's 「修改 X（N 个字段）→」 card variant is not built: no producer emits it. The update card keeps its own title and its "Open the full form" label.
- A proposal is applied only to a field the form draws and the person could edit: not read-only, disabled or hidden by its config, and not locked by a `readonlyWhen` rule on the stored record (the same `readonlyFieldNames` verdict the save strips by). cloud's `update_record` already proposes only fields the user may write (`record-draft-validation.ts`, rule 1).
- Each proposal is tried once per field, on the first pass where the form draws that field. An edit wizard draws one step at a time, so a step-2 proposal lands and is marked when step 2 opens, and a step-1 field the person reverted is not re-applied on Next or Back.
- The `Was: …` line formats the stored value without a lookup read: an option field reads its option label, an expanded lookup its name, a bare lookup id is shown as the id.
- Router state belongs to the tab's history entry, as for #28104: reload or Back to that entry reopens the proposals, a copied link opens the stored record.
- Serial behind objectstack#28104: opened after #31445 landed, with `main` merged into this branch by a merge commit (`229de9fb`); the delta over `main` is this card's alone.

## Review round 1 (head `79a39a9c`)

The seat review asked for two items, now done in `e50be7b9`. `79a39a9c` merges `main` `a1d243e0`, which carries the raised eager `i18n-locale-en` ceiling from objectstack#31465. These runs supersede the Verification readings above, which were taken at `229de9fb`.

### (1) Wizard: proposals tried per field
`suggestedChangeAttemptsRef` is a `Set<string>`. Each proposal is tried once, on the first pass where the form draws that field, and never again. A layout effect on `drawnFieldNames` covers a step change that brings no reset. The before line and the revert read `appliedChangeBefore`, which holds the stored value per applied field. They do not read `defaultValues`, because the wizard refills it at every step boundary.

The pin is a new file, `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/WizardForm.aiProposedChanges-28106.test.tsx`. It is an edit wizard with name on step 1 and phone on step 2:
- Step 1: name is applied and marked, then reverted.
- Next: phone is applied and marked on step 2, "Was: 13900001111".
- CONTROL: Back, then Next and Back again. Name stays reverted.

### (2) readonlyWhen
This was cheap, so it is done rather than left as a limit. The apply loop also skips `readonlyFieldNames.has(name)`, the same verdict the save strips by. That check is gated on `previousValues`, which both RecordFormPage edit and WizardForm edit supply.

The pin is a new cell in `form-aiSuggestedMark-28104.test.tsx`: a field locked by `readonlyWhen: "previous.status != 'draft'"` beside an unlocked one.
